title: Improve macOS filesystem compatibility, multi-file read performance and agent reliability.
changes: Fix regular-file metadata on macOS without relaxing allowed-root or symbolic-link protections.
Read multiple requested files with at most four concurrent workers while preserving order, cancellation, per-file errors and output limits.
Bound agent version checks including stalled response bodies; avoid reconnect storms during repeated relay redeployments.
Bound the local CLI diagnostic handshake and cleanup so stuck runtime children cannot indefinitely block remcp doctor.
Add focused regression tests for symlinks, path metadata, concurrent reads, update timeouts, reconnection and doctor cleanup.
Publish public runtime and client together before merging private changes and deploying to paired agents.
